detail.title: 2MP 25x Starlight WizSense Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD50225DB-HNY 2MP 25x Starlight WizSense Network PTZ Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 2MP Resolution • 25× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • High Preset and Manual Speed Make the PTZ Responsive • Optional Smoked Dome Cover for Enhanced Concealment • Enhanced Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Face Detection：Leveraging Facial Data to Enhance Analytics Accuracy • IP67 and IK10 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments • Supports PoE+ Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0°–360° endless Tilt: 0° to +90°, auto flip 180
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection,face bounding box, capturing snapshots, and enhancing face images. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing, and quality first
General.Auto Patrol: It triggers the IVS rule when a target is detected and makes the camera link with the PTZ to rotate to the position of the target and patrol based on its presets
General.Video Compression: H.264H; H.264B; Smart H.265+; H.264; H.265; MJPEG(Sub Stream); Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 1080p/1.3M/720p@(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF@(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p@(1–25/30 fps)
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 2048 Kbps–8192 Kbps H.265: 768 Kbps–6400 Kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view; multiple colors available
General.Audio Compression: G.711a; G.711Mu; G.726; MPEG2-Layer2; G722.1; G723; PCM
General.Network Protocol: TCP; FTP; RTMP; IPv6;Bonjour; IPv4; DNS; RTCP; PPPoE; NTP; RTP; 802.1x; HTTPS; SNMP; TCP/IP; DDNS; UPnP; NFS; ICMP; UDP; IGMP; IP Filter; SMB; HTTP; SSL; DHCP; SMTP; SNMPv1/v2c/v3(MIB-2); Qos; RTSP; ARP
General.Interoperability: CGI; Dahua SDK; API; SDK; ONVIF(Profile S&G&T)
General.Storage: DMSS; FTP; Micro SD card (512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE 7 and later versions Chrome 45 and later versions Firefox 52 ESR and earlier versions Safari
General.Certification: CE-EMC: EN 55032; EN 61000-3-3; EN 61000-3-2; EN 50130-4; EN 55035 CE-LVD: EN 62368-1 FCC: 47 CFR FCC Part15, Subpart B, NSI C63.4
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; preset; tour; pattern; recording; alarm digital input; send email
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card status detection; memory space detection
General.Protection: IP67, IK10,TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
